statement.plain_text: The equation ax + by = c has an integer solution if and only if gcd(a,b) divides c.
statement.markdown: The equation $ax + by = c$ has an integer solution if and only if $\gcd(a,b)$ divides $c$.

proof_outline_steps.plain_text: If ax + by = c has a solution, then every common divisor of a and b divides c.
proof_outline_steps.markdown: If $ax + by = c$ has a solution, then every common divisor of $a$ and $b$ divides $c$.

proof_outline_steps.plain_text: If gcd(a,b) divides c, write c = d*k with d = gcd(a,b).
Apply Bézout identity to d and multiply the resulting combination by k.
proof_outline_steps.markdown: Apply Bézout identity to $d$ and multiply the resulting combination by $k$.
